Name: Caroline Vanilla Remaster
Author: Jizua
Description:
Complete list of changes:
[list]
[*]Gave sideview sprites longer legs/dress so Caroline's height doesn't drop in her sideviews. This prevents her from looking squat when walking to the side.
[*]Removed the weird seam in her dress that makes her dress sometimes look like baggy pants.
[*]Changed her hair so her pigtails are always behind her shoulders, and are actually present in her back view. Kept the messy down hair in her workout view, though.
[*]Updated her beach outfit so her walking animation has a longer stride.
[*]Updated her swimsuit in the beach outfit to a one piece that fits her body a bit better, and doesn't lose form as much while she moves.
[/list]
Potential Future Updates:
[list]
[*]New version of her workout outfit (I'd like to give her some kind of 80s leotard and leggings)
[/list]
1.1 changes:
[list]
[*]Moved her head back one pixel in her Beach side view. Uploaded mod, then took one last look comparing the updated version to the vanilla version and realized her head looked too far forward in the Beach outfit. Doh!
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Moved her head back one pixel in her Beach side view to more closely match her regular version.

Manifest.Name: Caroline Vanilla Remaster
Manifest.Description: Changes Caroline's sprite so the sideview is the same height as the front, and gives her consistent pigtails'
Manifest.Author: jizua
